queries.ask: What version range of `jose` does the @auth/core package declare as a dependency?
Where is the GitHub OAuth provider implemented? Name the file.
What functions call the `encode` function from @auth/core's JWT module (packages/core/src/jwt.ts)? List up to 5 call sites.
queries.reference: Directly, in packages/core/src/lib/actions/callback/oauth/checks.ts: sealCookie, state.create and webauthnChallenge.create. Through options.jwt.encode (jwt.encode by default): session() in lib/actions/session.ts and callback() in lib/actions/callback/index.ts.

queries.ask: Which auth actions (URL path segments such as `/signin`) does @auth/core route requests to? List them all.
queries.reference: The AuthAction union in packages/core/src/types.ts (also listed in lib/utils/actions.ts): providers, session, csrf, signin, signout, callback, verify-request, error, webauthn-options.

queries.ask: Summarize what `packages/core/src/index.ts` does in 3 sentences. Name its main exported function and say what it takes and returns.
queries.reference: It is the @auth/core entry point. Its main export is the Auth function, which takes a standard web Request and an AuthConfig and returns a Response (a ResponseInternal when called with raw). It also re-exports helpers such as setEnvDefaults, createActionURL, isAuthAction and skipCSRFCheck.

queries.ask: Where is the database adapter interface defined?
Which test files cover the JWT encode/decode flow?
queries.reference: packages/core/test/jwt.test.ts imports encode/decode from the JWT module; packages/core/test/actions/session.test.ts and test/actions/callback.test.ts also encode and decode session tokens.

queries.ask: When an action is rejected because the CSRF token is missing, which error class is thrown, and in which file is that class defined?
queries.reference: validateCSRF (packages/core/src/lib/actions/callback/oauth/csrf-token.ts) throws MissingCSRF, which is defined in packages/core/src/errors.ts and extends SignInError.

queries.ask: What's the main entry point of the @auth/core package?
queries.reference: packages/core/package.json exports "." as ./index.js (types ./index.d.ts), built from packages/core/src/index.ts, whose main export is Auth.

queries.ask: Where is the `Session` type defined? Show me the file and signature.
queries.reference: packages/core/src/types.ts: `export interface Session extends DefaultSession {}`; DefaultSession has `user?: User` and `expires: ISODateString`.

queries.ask: Where do we push back a session's expiry date when the user keeps using the app?
queries.reference: session() in packages/core/src/lib/actions/session.ts. With JWT sessions it re-encodes the token with a new expiry (fromDate(maxAge)) and re-sets the cookie; with database sessions it calls adapter.updateSession once the session is older than session.updateAge.

queries.ask: How do we stop another website from submitting our sign-in form on a user's behalf?
queries.reference: A double-submit CSRF token: createCSRFToken and validateCSRF in packages/core/src/lib/actions/callback/oauth/csrf-token.ts. init.ts sets options.csrfTokenVerified and lib/index.ts calls validateCSRF on POSTs to signin, signout, callback and session.

queries.ask: When someone signs in with just their email address, where is the one-time login link created, and how is its token stored?
queries.reference: sendToken in packages/core/src/lib/actions/signin/send-token.ts makes a random token, builds the callback URL, calls provider.sendVerificationRequest, and stores a hash of token + secret through adapter.createVerificationToken.

queries.ask: What happens when the login cookie gets too big for the browser?
queries.reference: SessionStore in packages/core/src/lib/utils/cookie.ts splits the value into numbered chunks (name.0, name.1, …) of CHUNK_SIZE = 4096 − 160 bytes and joins them again when reading.

queries.ask: After someone logs in, how do we decide which page they land on, and what stops us from sending them to another website?
queries.reference: callbacks.redirect. The default (defaultCallbacks.redirect in packages/core/src/lib/init.ts) allows relative URLs and same-origin URLs and otherwise falls back to baseUrl; createCallbackUrl in lib/utils/callback-url.ts runs it on the callbackUrl parameter or cookie.

queries.ask: How do we make sure the response coming back from the OAuth provider belongs to the login we started?
queries.reference: packages/core/src/lib/actions/callback/oauth/checks.ts: state, PKCE (code_verifier) and nonce checks, each sealed in a short-lived encrypted cookie (sealCookie) and verified on the callback (useCookie/parseCookie), called from handleOAuth in callback.ts.
